fig1.title: Model residual against the table, by altitude
fig1.caption: Residual of four boiling-point models against the Engineering ToolBox table, from 0 to 8992 m at 119 table altitudes. Residual is model minus table, in kelvin. The isothermal, constant-enthalpy curve stays between 0 and about +0.6 K. Both ISA curves fall below zero, the constant-enthalpy one from about 3.5 km and the IAPWS one from about 4.5 km, and reach about -1.8 K and -2.6 K near 9 km. The drawing uses one line per model with markers at every fifth altitude.
